title: Pantalone Terms of Service
content:
Welcome to Pantalone!

Pantalone is designed for families to play games, track scores, and use family leaderboards. By using our Services, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.

TERMS OF SERVICE: QUICK GUIDE

  • Users can create up to 4 Player profiles for individuals under 16, but only if the User is the parent or legal guardian.
  • Users are responsible for all activity under their account, including that of their Players.

Intellectual Property

All content on Pantalone is owned by Samuel Wood unless otherwise stated.

You may use the Services for personal, non-commercial purposes only.

Third-Party Links

We link to other websites, but we are not responsible for their content.

Privacy Policy

You agree to our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and store User and Player data.

Feedback

If you provide feedback, we can use that Feedback to improve our existing Services or create new Services.

Errors and Omissions

We may correct errors or omissions in the Services without telling you.

Prohibited Uses

Do not use the Services to break the law, create Player profiles for individuals under 16 (unless you are their parent/guardian), impersonate others, or interfere with the Services. Violations may result in termination of your access.

Disclaimer

The Services are provided "as is" and "as available". We do not guarantee uninterrupted service.

Limitation of Liability

Samuel Wood and Pantalone are not liable for any damages or injury unless they have broken the law.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the Code civil de Québec, as Pantalone and its owner, Samuel Wood, are located in Montréal, Québec, Canada.

Changes to Terms

These terms can be changed at any time due to changes in the nature of the business or the laws governing the business. You will be notified on the website and, if you have requested, by email.

Contact Us

Questions? Email us at hello@pantalone.games.

  • You are responsible for all activity under your account and for maintaining the security of your credentials.
